purpose: Verifies an extract's Merkle inclusion against a root only when that root is anchored by a recognized source: a recognized OCG artifact/chain envelope, or an external anchor (RFC 3161 timestamp, OpenTimestamps, Sigstore transparency log, or an on-chain commitment composed via verify_eth_state_proof, VR-1). Explicitly refuses (anchored:false) a self-produced root with no recognized anchor class; the universal self-produced hash-chain explorer stays dead. Not-X-use-Y: use art-280 (verify_reserve_proof) for Merkle-SUM Proof-of-Reserves inclusion specifically; this kernel verifies plain (non-sum) Merkle inclusion for any anchored extract.
